The coach uses the Dynamic Mindfulness program, customized to each school's needs. The contract started October 14, 2019, before the Board's ratification vote, and the cost is capped at $65,000.
schools: Claremont; Montera; West Oakland Middle; Edna Brewer; Westlake
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Precita Eyes - Oakland High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Precita Eyes, San Francisco, CA, for the latter to collaborate with students to conduct a community-oriented design process that will result in a mural that will grace the school's sidewalk retainer wall on Park Blvd, as described in the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth at Oakland High School, for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00.
headline: Pays Precita Eyes up to $5,000 to lead students in designing a mural at Oakland High
summary: Precita Eyes, a San Francisco organization, will work with Oakland High School students on a community-focused design process. The result will be a mural on the school's sidewalk retaining wall on Park Boulevard. The contract runs August 12, 2019 to May 29, 2020 and is capped at $5,000; the Board is ratifying work already under way.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Award - NoVo Foundation - Social and Emotional Learning Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Grant Agreement (“Letter) between NoVo Foundation and the District, with the latter accepting $450,000.00 Grant, from the former for “Advancing Social and Emotional Learning in Oakland Schools: Network by Network” (the Proposal), awarded pursuant to the teams and conditions thereof, for the period August 1, 2019 through August 1, 2022.
headline: Accepts a $450,000 NoVo Foundation grant to advance social and emotional learning in Oakland schools
summary: The district is accepting a $450,000 grant from the NoVo Foundation for a project called "Advancing Social and Emotional Learning in Oakland Schools: Network by Network." The grant period runs from August 1, 2019 through August 1, 2022. The money comes into the district rather than being spent from its budget.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities Grant - Tobacco Use Prevention Education (TUPE) Program - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Acceptance by the Board of Education of a California Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities Grant Award from the California Department of Education, (CDE Grant No. 19-25444-61259-00) for the Tobacco Use Prevention Program (TUPE), in the amount of $250,00.00, for the period of July 1, 2018 through June 30, 2020, pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof.
funding_source: Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities Grant
headline: Accepts a California Department of Education tobacco-prevention youth engagement grant
summary: The district accepts a Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities grant of $250,000 from the California Department of Education for its Tobacco Use Prevention Education program, serving 11 middle and high school sites. The attached grant award covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The agenda text misprints the amount as "$250,00.00" and gives a 2018 start date.
source_issue: The grant amount is printed as "$250,00.00" and the period as starting July 1, 2018; the attached grant award shows $250,000.00 for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Student Travel - Portland, Oregon - Oakland High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-0172 - Authorization for Approval of Student Travel by school site Oakland High School to Cleveland High School, Portland, Oregon, for sixteen (16) 9th through 12th grade boys basketball student athletes and four (4) adults, as specified in Out of State Field Trip/Excursion Request, attached, for the period of December 4, 2019 through December 8, 2019, to play two basketball games and to attend a Portland Trailblazers NBA game, at no cost to the District.
headline: Approves Oakland High boys basketball trip to Portland, Oregon at no cost to the district
summary: The Board is approving out-of-state travel for sixteen Oakland High School boys basketball players in grades 9 through 12 and four adults. The group will travel to Cleveland High School in Portland, Oregon from December 4 to December 8, 2019 to play two basketball games and attend a Portland Trail Blazers game. The trip costs the district nothing.
schools: Oakland High School; Cleveland High School
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Tommy Chang - Office of the Chief of Staff
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Tommy Chang, Villa Park, CA, for the latter provide support for strategic planning by: 1) Reviewing various plans and artifacts; 2) Refining metrics and communication strategies to drive work in District and the community; 3) Publish an updated Strategic Plan by the end of SY 2019-20; 4) Support Deputy Chief of Communications with the development of Communications Plan for 2019-20 that includes key theme messages for the year. (Begin with LCAP metrics- e.g., improving on disproportionality, central kitchen project, grad rates, attendance, etc.); and 5) Provide direct support to Superintendent and senior leadership (to include Chief Academic Officer, Chief Systems & Services Officer, Deputy Chief Talent, Chief of Staff and Superintendent), by providing delineated tasks, described in the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Office of the Chief of Staff, for the period of November 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $78,000.00.
headline: Pays a consultant up to $78,000 to support district strategic planning through June 2020
summary: A consultant based in Villa Park, CA will review district plans, refine metrics, publish an updated Strategic Plan by the end of the 2019-20 school year, and help draft the communications plan. The consultant will also provide direct support to the Superintendent and senior leadership. The contract runs November 1, 2019 to June 30, 2020 and is capped at $78,000.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Proposition 39 Facility Use Agreement - Urban Montessori Charter School - [Sherman Elementary School (In Part)] - 2019-2020 School Year
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of the Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement between the District and Urban Montessori, a Charter School, for use of classrooms at Sherman Campus, 5328 Brann Street, Oakland, CA 94619, for the 2019-20 School Year serving Grades TK to 3, one year only, with annual revenue to the District of $77,352.66.
headline: Leases Sherman campus classrooms to Urban Montessori Charter for $77,352.66 in 2019-20
summary: Under Proposition 39, the state law on charter school facilities, the district will let Urban Montessori, a charter school, use classrooms at the Sherman campus on Brann Street for the 2019-20 school year. The charter serves grades TK to 3, and the agreement covers one year only. The district will receive $77,352.66.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
